boundary_decisions.rationale: Qualification owns profiles and receipts but lacks an independent user outcome, economics and lifecycle distinct from compiler binding and conformance assurance.
Telemetry, SLO evaluation, incident/service management, support and per-product operational duty have different owners; packaging does not prove one product.
A compiled or provider plan is not an authorized apply, successful reconciliation or accepted business outcome.
Entitlement, authorization, quota, budget and physical capacity are independent gates.
Telemetry observations require scoped SLI/SLO evaluation before any health claim.
Requested, allocated and consumed resources; normalized costs; allocated costs; prices; charges and invoices are distinct.
Agents may propose intent or diagnoses; deterministic typing, solving, qualification, authority, resource control, cost allocation and receipts remain authoritative.
